build.title: Recompute Data
build.confirm:
This recomputes the comparison from the newest WINGS export (02) and the newest production-month SAM folder (01) on SharePoint.
It runs in this browser (1–3 minutes) and the result is saved to SharePoint (05. output) for everyone.
The model mapping workbook (03. model_rules) also gets its recognition and diagnostics sheets refreshed.

Continue?

matching.legend:
Model rename a WINGS model name equal to From becomes To (one way). The new name is the dashboard Type and the number used to find the SAM.
From is the WINGS spelling without the axle (e.g. 2651 LS); To matches the SAM document's file-name or body Vehicle type number (e.g. 2851 LS).
After editing, Save to SharePoint; the next Recalculate data applies it.
